item.title: New Street Fighter Movie Ends on the Strangest Song Choice Possible
item.description: The soundtrack to Capcom and Legendary's new Street Fighter movie is nothing if not eclectic. The film's music choices skew heavily toward the '90s, during which Street Fighter is set, with songs like Tupac's "Ambitionz Az A Ridah," Soundgarden's "Black Hole Sun," and Meredith Brooks' "Bitch," but it's not afraid to dip into other decades. It's understandable why 50 Cent's "Many Men (Wish Death)" plays during a fight featuring boxer Balrog (who is played by 50 Cent), even if the song feels temporally out of place.

item.title: Stephen King Meets 'The Backrooms' in Syfy's Underrated 6-Part Anthology Series
item.description: Channel Zero embraced a wide gamut of horror tales, with each season focused on a different creepypasta, but season 4, "The Dream Door," is a particularly engrossing watch. Based on " Hidden Door ," a short story written by Charlotte Bywater and originally published on the subreddit r/nosleep, this six-episode saga delves into the terror of eerie liminal spaces, while mixing in a marital drama that’s more sinister than it appears at first glance.

item.title: 26 Years Ago, 'Buffy the Vampire Slayer' Officially Launched Its Most Controversial Couple
item.description: It comes at the end of an episode that, for all intents and purposes, is pure setup. Spike (James Marsters) lounges morosely in his crypt, harmless after having a chip installed in his brain that prevents him from hurting humans. Buffy (Sarah Michelle Gellar) kicks down his door and announces that she’s done with him. She’s killing him once and for all.

item.title: Event Habitat Dex and Pokédex list in Pokémon Pokopia
item.description: Pokémon Pokopia has limited-time events that occur for a few days before disappearing, though you can time travel back to them, if you miss out on any. Some events feature Pokémon and habitats you can only unlock via the event, so you'll want to make sure you're paying attention to any guests who are the "talk of the town."

item.title: 10 Perfect Detective Thrillers That Get More Intense With Every Episode
item.description: Nothing hits quite like a good mystery. Whether it's a seemingly impossible murder, a missing person, or a conspiracy set against the backdrop of a small town, the best TV mysteries keep you guessing right up until the credits roll. They're the kinds of shows that make you scrutinize every passing detail and second-guess each new character. Still, despite the overriding conviction that you cracked the case long before the detectives, it’s almost always someone you least expect.

item.title: Beloved Fantasy Novel Series Redwall Sets Return After 16 Years
item.description: For 25 years from 1986 to 2011, writer Brian Jacques stole the hearts of readers everywhere with his Redwall series of fantasy novels . The Rogue Crew was released in 2011, three months after Jacques' death, and for 15 years it has remained the final entry in the series — until now.

item.title: Rockstar Officially Comments on GTA 6's Approach to Trump & COVID-19
item.description: Rockstar Games is known for bringing biting and often puerile satire to its Grand Theft Auto games. The 13-year span between Grand Theft Auto 5 and Grand Theft Auto 6 means there's plenty of American culture to interrogate or poke fun at, but a few things will be off the table, according to new previews of Rockstar's upcoming game. Two things that GTA 6 won't directly address, according to a new report: Donald Trump’s rise to political power and the COVID-19 pandemic.
